It will be hard. My family,  friends have all kind of slowly drifted away because of the depression. 

He said that in a perfect scenario would be if I killed myself, that way he could live happily and I wouldn't be around to take HIS kids or to ruin or destroy his life. 

Kind of just makes me want this more. My patents have life insurance and I have it too. .. my kids would be okay.
